headline: BCG Says Health Systems Are Missing AI's Patient Access Opportunity
summary: BCG published a report arguing health systems are missing their biggest AI opportunity in patient access, including scheduling, referral management, and digital navigation. McKinsey published a concurrent executive piece on capturing AI's 'true value' in health systems. Two major strategy firms staking out health system AI advisory territory in the same week is a competitive signal worth noting. Your clients will see these frameworks. Be ready with the response that grounds the framework in their specific VBC obligations and operational constraints rather than a generic AI priority list.
so_what: BCG published a framework arguing that health systems are underinvesting in AI for patient access, specifically scheduling, referral management, and care navigation. This is BCG staking out a practice area and telling health system leaders they're behind. Expect client questions about this within two weeks.
original_title: BCG: Health systems missing AI's biggest patient access opportunity
